nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
- <Picture 1>: A young woman (older sister) with short brown hair, wearing a green tracksuit with white stripes on the sleeves and legs.
- <Picture 2>: A muscular young man (younger brother) with messy black hair, wearing a white tank top and dark shorts.
- <Picture 3>: A stern navy officer (Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force style) in a dark blue sailor-style uniform and an officer's peaked cap.
- <Picture 4>: The flight deck of a modern aircraft carrier, featuring a large grey bridge tower and a flat asphalt-like deck with white markings under a clear sky.

summary:
A 10-second high-quality anime-style video set on an aircraft carrier deck. Two siblings (<Picture 1> and <Picture 2>) are caught loitering by a stern officer (<Picture 3>). The scene is comedic and expressive, focusing on character interactions and dialogue.

retention_analysis:
- <Picture 1>: fully_preserved. Her green tracksuit and short hairstyle must be maintained throughout.
- <Picture 2>: fully_preserved. His muscular physique and white tank top must be consistent.
- <Picture 3>: fully_preserved. His formal naval uniform and angry facial expression must be accurate.
- <Picture 4>: fully_preserved. This serves as the fixed environment for the entire scene.

detailed_description:
- [0s-3s]: The scene opens with a medium shot on the carrier deck (<Picture 4>). The older sister (<Picture 1>) and the younger brother (<Picture 2>) are standing side-by-side. They are both leaning in to look at the smartphone held by the sister. The sister looks frustrated, shaking the phone and shouting <d>[Japanese] 「電波ないじゃん！」</d>. The brother looks at her with a deadpan, exasperated face, sighing at her behavior.
- [3s-7s]: The camera angle widens as the navy officer (<Picture 3>) enters the frame from behind the siblings, walking with a brisk, heavy pace. His face is contorted with anger. He stands behind them and yells authoritatively, <d>[Japanese] 「遊びに来たのか？」</d>.
- [7s-10s]: Reaction shot. The younger brother (<Picture 2>) winces with a guilty and awkward expression, shrinking his shoulders. In contrast, the older sister (<Picture 1>) turns around, raises her smartphone high towards the sky as if searching for a signal, and pouts her cheeks in a sulky, defiant manner while whining, <d>[Japanese] 「だってー！」</d>. The camera focuses on her expressive, puffed-out face.

overall_soundscape:
The ambient sound of wind blowing across an open sea deck, the faint hum of ship machinery, and the rhythmic metallic clank of the officer's boots. Clear, expressive Japanese voice acting for the dialogue.

non_diegetic_music:
A lighthearted, comedic orchestral track that emphasizes the "slice-of-life" comedy style, with a brief dramatic orchestral sting when the officer appears.
